SELECT 
    a.prim_dx AS diagnosis,
    c.clin_key AS clinician,
    COUNT(p.pat_key) AS patient_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.prim_dx ORDER BY COUNT(p.pat_key) DESC) AS rank
FROM patients p
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON p.pat_owner_ref = ab.ab_key
JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a ON ab.ab_key = a.asd_key
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk s ON ab.ab_key = s.asr_key
WHERE (s.phq9_scr > 19 OR s.gad7_scr > 14)
  AND s.suic_risk = 'High'
GROUP BY a.prim_dx, c.clin_key
ORDER BY a.prim_dx, rank;
